account_access_trial_dates_check.name: account_access_trial_dates_check
account_access_trial_dates_check.value: "account_access"."trial_status" <> 'active' or ("account_access"."trial_started_at" is not null and "account_access"."trial_ends_at" is not null)

video_events_conversion_fields_check.name: video_events_conversion_fields_check
video_events_conversion_fields_check.value:
"video_events"."event_type" <> 'conversion' or (
        "video_events"."transaction_id" is not null and char_length("video_events"."transaction_id") between 1 and 120 and
        "video_events"."conversion_value" is not null and "video_events"."conversion_value" >= 0 and
        "video_events"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'
      )
